desc: Ideation: equivalence to even-color assignment and top-2K parity T-join correction framework.
Implement input parsing, base top-2K selection, base sum, default colors, and parity mask.
Build exact top-two aggregates for selected M by color, directed recolor losses, and unselected color values.
Implement single-edge and two-edge pair cost with resource-distinct constraints (RR, RS, SR, SS).
Compute minimum parity loss (direct or path via third color), output answers, and test against samples and brute force for small N.
